name: M5GroqBot Voice Chatbot
author: Coreymillia
description: Voice-activated AI chatbot powered by Groq. Speak your questions and get instant AI responses with word-wrapped text and customizable colors.
features: AI chat responses via Groq LLM
Fixed button controls - tap to scroll, hold to color
requirements: Groq API key (get free at groq.com)
instructions: 1. On first boot, device creates WiFi AP 'M5GroqBot-Setup'
2. Connect to AP and enter your WiFi credentials
3. Enter your Groq API key in the setup page
4. Device will connect to WiFi and show READY screen
5. Press Button A to record your question (speak for 2 seconds)
6. View transcription and AI response on screen
7. Tap Button B to scroll up, hold to cycle colors
8. Use PWR button to scroll down
9. Press PWR at end of message to reset for next question

controls.Power Button: Scroll down / Reset for next question
